situation: My friend Nadia has spent a year in a legal fight with her former business partner, and the court hearing is next Tuesday. She's been quiet in our group chat for weeks. I'm free Wednesday evening and I'm a decent cook.
reply: Hey Nadia, I know Tuesday is the hearing and I've been thinking about you. No need to reply to this. I'll send you one text that evening just to say hi, nothing to answer. And whatever happens, come to mine for dinner on Wednesday at 7 if you fancy it; we don't have to talk about any of it.
note: When a hard date is coming, mark it without asking for a report and put something gentle on the day after.

situation: 大学室友小林研究生没考上，已经一个多星期没在群里说话了。我私聊问她还好吗，她就回了一句'挺好的'。
reply: 好，我信你。不过如果哪天不太好了，半夜两点也可以直接找我，不用理由。周六我去你们学校附近那家火锅店，你想来就来，不想说话光吃也行。
note: 第一次说'挺好的'就先接住，不追问，把门留着，再给一个具体、可以轻松拒绝的邀约。

situation: My coworker Mark has been on sick leave for cancer treatment for two months. We're not super close but I liked working with him; he was famous for the terrible pun he slipped into his March all-hands talk. I texted once a month ago, no reply.
reply: Hi Mark, the team was talking about your terrible pun in the March all-hands today and it made me think of you. No need to reply. Just wanted you to know you're missed around here.
note: After silence, send something that needs zero response and never mention the unanswered text.

situation: Mi amiga Carmen perdió el trabajo hace un mes. Le escribí varias veces ofreciéndole ayuda con el currículum y hoy me contestó: 'deja de tratarme como un proyecto'.
reply: Tienes razón, me pasé de insistente. Me echo para atrás. La oferta no caduca y aquí sigo, sin prisa y sin preguntas.
note: No defiendas tu intención. Cumple lo que dices y reaparece en un par de semanas con algo pequeño que no tenga nada que ver con el trabajo.

situation: 妈妈走了半年，爸爸一个人住在老家。每次打电话他都说'挺好的，你别操心'，但邻居说他最近很少出门，以前他最爱去河边钓鱼，也爱吃老街那家羊肉粉。国庆我能回去几天。
reply: 爸，我10月2号下午到家，待到6号。这几天你别做饭，我带你去老街吃那家羊肉粉，再陪你去河边钓两天鱼。你什么都不用准备。平时想说说话了，随时打给我，不用找理由。
note: 给独居的老人，打电话问不出实话：别追问，直接定下带日期的陪伴，把他以前爱做的事重新带回来，再留一扇门。

situation: I manage a small team. My report Priyanka told me briefly that her mum went into hospice last week. She's still logging on every day and says she's fine. She owns the Kessler report, due next week, and Thursday's client call, which Jamal can cover. I want to check in without making her feel watched.
reply: Priyanka, I'm thinking of you and your mum this week. No need to reply to this. I've moved the Kessler report to October 16 and Jamal is covering Thursday's client call, so both are off your plate. If you want to take days, just tell me which ones; you don't need to explain.
note: From a manager the most useful concrete help is taking work away, done already, not offered. No questions she has to answer.

situation: My friend Leo texted me at 1am 'honestly I don't see the point of any of it anymore' and then nothing. He lost his job in August and his girlfriend moved out last month. We're both in Chicago, he's 20 minutes from me.
reply: Leo, I'm really glad you told me. I'm worried about you and I'd rather ask than wonder: are you thinking about ending your life? Whatever the answer is, you can tell me. I'm awake, and I can be at yours in 20 minutes, or stay on the phone with you while you call or text 988. Reply with anything and I'll call you straight away.
note: Ask directly; it does not plant the idea. If he says yes, or you can't reach him and fear for his life, call 911. That one is not yours to carry alone.

situation: 好朋友阿敏生完孩子两个多月，朋友圈好久没更新。上次视频她一直哭，说没睡过一个整觉。我们住同一个城市，她楼下有家她爱喝的粥铺，我想帮点实际的忙。
reply: 阿敏，这几天一直惦记你，不用回我。周六上午10点我过去帮你抱两个小时娃，你去睡一觉，午饭我从你楼下那家粥铺带上来。不方便的话回个“改天”就行，一点不用客气。
note: 不问“你还好吗”，只给一个带时间、容易接受也容易拒绝的具体帮忙。

situation: My older sister Hannah is a nurse who has been working extra shifts since the summer and doing most of the parenting for her two kids, Mia and Owen, on her own. Every time I tell her to rest she snaps that she can't. I live across town.
reply: Han, you've been running on empty for months and I can see it. I'm not going to tell you to rest, you've heard it enough. I'll take Mia and Owen to the park and then to ours for lunch on Sunday, 10 till 4, so you get an actual day. Just reply 'yes' or 'not this week'.
note: With burnout, drop the advice they've already heard and take a block of their load away, with a time on it and an easy no.

situation: My friend Tom went quiet for about a month after his startup shut down. I've sent a couple of low-key texts. He just replied: 'sorry I've been a ghost, honestly things are pretty bad right now.' I don't want to blow this.
reply: No sorry needed, I'm really glad you told me. Can I call you tonight around 8? If talking feels like too much, just reply 'text' and we'll do it this way instead.
note: When they finally open up, show up fast and small: no advice, no questions that need a report, one concrete offer with an easy way to shrink it. If he hints he doesn't want to be here, ask him directly whether he's safe, and if he might act on it, call your local emergency number or help him reach a crisis line.

situation: 同组同事小周请了两个月病假，私下跟我说过是抑郁症在治疗，组里其他人只知道是“身体原因”。他下周一回来上班，就坐我旁边。我们以前常一起去公司后面那家面馆吃午饭。
reply: 小周，听说你下周一回来，挺高兴的。不用回我。回来那天中午，要不要一起去后面那家面馆？不想去就说“改天”，一点问题都没有。
note: 知道内情也别在消息里提病名或病假原因，更别当着同事问；像平常一样给一个小邀约，让他自己决定说多少。

situation: My friend Jess has been really low since her divorce in the spring. We talk every Thursday and she keeps saying she can't sleep and can't see it getting better, but she's never mentioned therapy. I want to suggest it once without it sounding like I'm handing her off.
reply: I'm always going to be here for our Thursday calls, that's not changing. I also think you deserve more support than one call a week can give. If you ever want a hand finding someone to talk to, I'll help you look, or sit with you while you book it. No judgment, just an offer, and I won't bring it up again unless you do.
note: Professional help gets one warm line, as an option, never a verdict. 'Can't see it getting better' can hide more: if she ever talks about not wanting to be here, ask her directly whether she's thinking of ending her life, and if she might act on it, call your local emergency number or help her reach a crisis line.

situation: My friend Emma has been caring for her dad, who has dementia, since the spring, on top of her full-time job. Whenever I ask how she is, she only talks about him. I live ten minutes away.
reply: Emma, I've been thinking about you, not just your dad. You're carrying so much, and no need to reply properly to this. I'm free Saturday afternoon and could sit with him from 2 to 5 so you can do whatever you like, even if that's sleeping. Just reply 'yes' or 'not this week', both are completely fine.
note: Caregivers deflect to the patient; name her, and offer help that frees her time rather than more talk.

situation: My mutual friend Priya told me that Sam, my old uni flatmate, had to close his restaurant in Leeds last month. We haven't spoken in about four years; in second year he cooked lamb for our whole corridor. I'm in Leeds for work on Thursday 15 October.
reply: Hi Sam, Priya mentioned the restaurant closed last month, and I've been thinking about you since. I still remember the lamb you cooked for our whole corridor in second year. No need to reply to this, I know it's been ages. I'm in Leeds for work on Thursday 15 October; if you fancy a pint that evening, I'm buying, and if not, no worries at all.
note: After years of silence, say how you heard and keep it light: one shared memory, one offer, and a release so the gap never becomes his problem.

situation: Ma voisine du dessous, Mme Bernard, 84 ans, vit seule depuis que sa fille est partie au Canada cet été. Avant, on discutait souvent à la boulangerie, mais depuis un mois ses volets restent fermés et je ne la croise plus. Je vais au marché tous les samedis matin et j'habite au 3e.
reply: Chère Madame Bernard, nos discussions à la boulangerie me manquent et je pense souvent à vous. Je vais au marché samedi matin : si vous voulez que je vous rapporte quelque chose, glissez simplement un petit mot sous ma porte, au 3e. Et si vous n'avez besoin de rien, aucune réponse n'est nécessaire. Bien amicalement, votre voisine du 3e
note: Pour une voisine âgée et isolée, un mot glissé sous la porte vaut mieux qu'un message : une aide concrète, une façon simple de l'accepter, et aucune obligation de répondre.

situation: 我们组上周裁了三个人，跟我搭档了两年的同事阿杰在名单里，我留下了。我们以前常下班去公司楼下那家烧烤店。这几天想联系他，又怕显得是在炫耀或者可怜他，一直没发。
reply: 阿杰，上周的事我一直惦记着你。这事跟你的能力没关系，这两年我最放心的搭档就是你。不用回我。周六晚上7点我请你去楼下那家烧烤，想聊就聊，不想聊就光吃。不方便回个“改天”就行。
note: 留下的人别绕开这件事，也别说自己多愧疚让他反过来安慰你；内推、当推荐人这类帮忙，等他开口再提。

situation: My daughter Chloe started university in Glasgow three weeks ago, 400 miles from home. On our usual Sunday call she said everyone else seems to have made friends already, then changed the subject. She hates being fussed over.
reply: Hi love, I've been thinking about you since Sunday. No need to reply properly to this. I'd like to post you a parcel on Friday with the good biscuits and the blanket from the sofa; just say 'no parcel' if you'd rather not. I'll ring at our usual time on Sunday, and if you want me sooner, text 'call'.
note: With a homesick young adult, skip the pep talk and the questions: one small comfort, the usual call, and an easy way to ask for more.

situation: 好朋友阿哲上周和谈了五年的女朋友小安分手了，小安也是我的好朋友，我们三个以前经常一起吃饭。阿哲这几天一条动态都没发，我想给他发个消息，但不想让他觉得我在打听或者站队。
reply: 阿哲，听说你和小安的事了，这几天一直惦记你。你们俩之间的事我不打听，也不会传话，不用跟我讲细节，也不用回这条。周六下午我想去江边走走，你想一起就说一声，不想就当没看到。
note: 和两人都是朋友时，先说清楚自己不打听、不传话，再给一个具体、可以直接拒绝的邀约。

situation: My friend Rosa has long COVID and has cancelled on me three times since July, always at the last minute and always with a long apology. She just cancelled Saturday's lunch and said 'I'm sorry, I'm the worst friend, you should stop inviting me.' I miss her and don't want her to feel guilty.
reply: You're not the worst friend, you're a friend with a body that's being unfair to you, and none of this needs an apology. I'm not going to stop inviting you. Next time how about I bring lunch to yours and we eat on the sofa, and if it's a bad day you can cancel on the morning with one emoji.
note: Lift the guilt first, then shrink the plan to one she can manage and make cancelling cost her nothing.

situation: 我最好的朋友阿琪在德国读博第三年，这一个多月微信基本不回，上次聊天她说导师让她把论文的一章全部重写。她那边比我们晚6个小时。我在国内过不去，想发条消息，但不想给她压力。
reply: 阿琪，最近一直在想你，这条不用回。这周六你那边上午10点、我这边下午4点，我想给你打个十分钟的视频，不聊论文，就看看你。不方便的话回个“下次”就好，一个字都不用多解释。
note: 隔着时差：替对方把时间换算好，把话题限定得很小，让她用两个字就能拒绝。

situation: My friend Dan's ground-floor flat flooded in last Thursday's storm and he's staying on his sister's sofa across town. He posted that he lost most of his furniture and books, but hasn't said much else. I have a car and I'm free this Saturday.
reply: Dan, I saw your post about the flat and I've been thinking about you since. No need to reply properly to this. I'm free Saturday and can bring the car over to help shift whatever's ruined, or do a run to the tip, from 10 till whenever you like. Just reply 'Saturday' or 'not this week', both are completely fine.
note: After a disaster the useful help is physical and dated; skip the silver linings and don't ask for a list of what was lost.

situation: My close friend Grace told me last week that her third IVF round failed. I'm 20 weeks pregnant and she knows. I haven't messaged since because I'm scared anything from me will hurt. We usually swim together on Sunday mornings.
reply: Grace, I've been thinking about you all week since you told me about the third round. I know I might be a hard person to be around right now, and that's completely okay; you don't have to look after my feelings. Swim on Sunday morning if you'd like it, skip it if you wouldn't, either is fine. No need to reply.
note: When you have what they're grieving, name it once, give them permission to keep their distance, and leave the usual plan open.

situation: 大学同学阿斌上周被电信诈骗骗走了8万块，是他攒了三年准备付首付的钱。他已经报了警，在群里说了一句“我真是蠢到家了”之后就再没出现。我们在同一个城市，平时周六上午会一起打球。
reply: 阿斌，听说了上周的事，这几天一直惦记你。被骗不是因为你蠢，那帮人就是专门干这个的。不用回我。周六上午老地方打球，我给你留着位置；不想动的话，我带两份炒粉去你家楼下也行。回个“球”或者“粉”就好，都不想也完全没关系。
note: 被骗之后最重的是羞愧：一句话把“蠢”卸下来，不问细节、不问钱能不能追回，只给一个容易接受也容易拒绝的邀约。

situation: My friend Marcus was 18 months sober and told me on Tuesday that he drank again over the weekend. He says he's ashamed and has been avoiding everyone since. We usually get coffee on Wednesday mornings before work at the place by the station.
reply: Marcus, thank you for telling me, I know that wasn't easy. Eighteen months still counts, and nothing about this changes how I see you. No need to reply properly to this. I'll be at our usual spot by the station on Wednesday morning and I'd love to see you there; if you'd rather not, just send 'next week' and that's completely fine.
note: No lecture, no day counting, no questions about meetings unless he raises them; the job is to lower the shame, not to fix the drinking. If he says he feels unsafe or talks about harming himself, call emergency services or a crisis line with him.

situation: 同期の山本くんが先週、課長昇進試験に落ちたと人づてに聞きました。それから昼ご飯も一人で食べていて、チャットの返事も短いです。私は試験を受けていません。前はよく二人で会社近くのラーメン屋に行っていました。
reply: 山本くん、試験のこと聞きました。結果がどうでも、山本くんの仕事ぶりの評価は私の中で変わらないです。返信は気にしないでね。金曜のお昼、久しぶりにあのラーメン屋行かない？気が乗らなければ「また今度」の一言で全然大丈夫です。
note: 職場の同僚には詳しく聞かず、いつもの場所への小さな誘いと、一言で断れる逃げ道だけを添える。

situation: 我在游戏里认识的网友“小鹿”，一起打了三年游戏，从没见过面，她在马来西亚。上周她在群里说自己被裁员了，之后每周二晚上我们固定的开黑她都没上线。我只有她的微信，想发条消息，又怕太突然。
reply: 小鹿，看到你上周在群里说的事了，这几天一直惦记你。不用回我。周二晚上我照样上线，你想来就来，不想说话光打游戏也行，不来也完全没关系。哪天想找人说说话，随时找我。
note: 没见过面的网友，就用你们本来就有的东西（每周二的开黑）当邀约，不追问细节，也不要求回复。

situation: My friend Lena moved in with her boyfriend Ben in the spring and I've barely seen her since. She's cancelled our last three plans saying Ben doesn't like her going out without him, and she mentioned he checks her phone. I want to stay in touch without criticising him, since he might read it.
reply: Hey Lena, I've missed you and I've been thinking about you. No need to reply to this. Whatever's going on in your life, I'm not going anywhere, and you never have to explain anything to me. I'm walking by the canal on Sunday at 11 if you fancy joining, and if not, I'll text again next week.
note: Keep it neutral in case it's read by someone else and keep showing up; a domestic abuse helpline can advise you on how to support her, and if you ever think she's in danger, call emergency services.

situation: My friends Ola and Ben's baby, Zuri, was born seven weeks early on Sunday and is in the neonatal unit; Ola posted a photo in our group chat and said they're basically living at the hospital. Their dog, Miso, is at home. I live five minutes from them and I have their spare key.
reply: Ola, Ben, I saw the photo of Zuri and I've been thinking about all three of you. No need to reply to this. I've got your spare key, so I can walk and feed Miso every morning and evening this week, starting tomorrow. Just send 'yes' or 'not now', either is completely fine.
note: With a baby in hospital, take a job at home off their list instead of asking for updates; they'll share news when they want to.

situation: 同事兼好朋友小美上周在小红书发了一篇吐槽加班的帖子，被几千人骂，还有人扒出了她的公司，她这几天请了假，微信也基本不回。她每天都要喝楼下那家奶茶店的杨枝甘露。我们住得很近，我想给她发条消息。
reply: 小美，这几天一直在想你，这条不用回。网上那些话说的不是你，认识你的人都知道。周四下班我给你带一杯楼下那家的杨枝甘露，放你家门口就走，想下楼聊两句也行，不想见人也完全没关系。回个“好”或者“改天”就行。
note: 不提评论内容，也不劝她“别看了”，只给一个不用见面也能接受的关心。如果有人威胁她的安全，帮她截图留证并报警（110）；如果她流露出不想活的念头，直接问她，必要时打120或心理援助热线。

situation: My friend Mateo, who's from Colombia, just found out his work visa renewal was refused and he has to leave London by 15 November, after six years here. He posted 'well, that's that' in our group chat and nothing since. I live two streets away and I'm free on Sunday.
reply: Mateo, I saw your message and I've been thinking about you since. Six years here, that's a huge thing to be hit with, and you don't need to have a plan yet. No need to reply to this. I'll bring lunch round on Sunday at 1 if you'd like company; just reply 'yes' or 'not this week', both are completely fine.
note: Skip the appeals and advice for now; if he asks for practical help later, help him find a qualified immigration adviser.

situation: 我是研究生导师张老师。硕士生小何已经两周没来组会，微信也只回过一句“不好意思老师”，上学期他提过父亲住院的事。我已经把他的开题报告从10月底挪到了11月底，每周四下午我都在办公室。想关心他一下，又不想让他觉得是在催论文。
reply: 小何，这两周没见到你，有点惦记你，这条不用急着回。开题报告的时间我已经帮你挪到11月底了，组会想来就来，不来也没关系，论文的事先放一放。每周四下午我都在办公室，哪天想过来坐坐、聊点别的，直接过来就行。
note: 导师的关心容易被听成催进度：先把压力拿掉，不问原因；学校的心理咨询等他愿意时再提一句，如果他流露出不想活的念头，直接问他是否安全，必要时打120或心理援助热线。

situation: My friend Ollie became a dad six weeks ago, and everyone asks him about the baby or his wife Priya. At five-a-side last week he admitted he's barely sleeping and feels useless. He lives 15 minutes from me, and I'm making a big lasagne on Sunday.
reply: Ollie, everyone's asking about the baby, so this one's just for you. No need to reply. I'm making a big lasagne on Sunday and could drop half round at 5; I'll hand it over at the door and go, unless you fancy ten minutes on the step. Just reply 'yes' or 'not this week', both are completely fine.
note: New dads rarely get asked; name him, skip the advice, and if the low mood drags on, offer once to help him find support. If he talks about harming himself, call emergency services.

situation: My friend Aisha's flat was broken into on Monday night while she was asleep; the police have been, and she's still living there. She posted that she hasn't slept properly since. I live 15 minutes away and could stay over on Friday 9 October with my air mattress and a takeaway.
reply: Aisha, I saw your post about Monday night and I've been thinking about you since. No need to reply properly to this. I could come and stay over on Friday 9 October, with my air mattress and a takeaway, so you're not on your own for a night. Just reply 'yes' or 'not this time', both are completely fine.
note: After a break-in, company at night is the concrete help; if she ever feels unsafe, she should call emergency services, and a victim support service can help with the aftermath.

situation: My friend Hollie called off her wedding to Sam last week; it was meant to be Saturday 17 October. She hasn't posted anything since, and she told me she can't face ringing the florist, the photographer and the band to cancel. I'm free Saturday morning and I'm good on the phone.
reply: Hollie, I've been thinking about you all week. No need to reply properly to this. If it would help, I could come over on Saturday morning and make the calls to the florist, the photographer and the band for you, so you don't have to say it out loud three times. Just reply 'yes' or 'not this week', both are completely fine.
note: Take the dreaded admin off her plate instead of asking what happened; she'll share the why if and when she wants to.

situation: 弟弟小凯15岁，读初三，我在深圳工作。妈妈说他最近在学校被几个同学孤立，回家就关在房间里，饭也吃得少。他平时只在QQ上跟我聊游戏，最爱吃家楼下那家牛肉面，我下周六回家。
reply: 小凯，最近老想起你，这条不用回。下周六我回家，中午带你去楼下那家牛肉面，就咱俩，吃完陪你打两把游戏。想聊什么都行，不想聊也没关系。平时想吐槽什么，QQ上随时找我。
note: 对青少年别追问学校的事，也别急着给建议；如果他提到不想活或想伤害自己，直接问他是否安全，马上告诉父母和学校，必要时打120或心理援助热线。
